jobs.description: Employer: CSEA Expires: 10/31/2026 The Civil Service Employees Association (CSEA), one of New York's largest labor unions, are recruiting college juniors and seniors for two paid (and full credit eligible) full-time legislative internships for the 2027 New York State legislative session. CSEA interns will learn the ins and outs of the New York State government and legislative process. Interns are the eyes and ears of CSEA at the state capital and will be tasked with attending press conferences, committee meetings, and legislative session. In addition, interns will be charged with keeping CSEA staff briefed in important legislative and political developments across the state. At its core, this internship helps students learn how the legislative process really works from an insiders perspective. You will learn how to write and analyze legislation, and learn how to lobby legislators and staff on issues important to CSEA members.This internship will give you opportunities to meet true decision makers in Albany. You will not sit at your desk all day making photo copies - you will be an integral part of our department and will be given opportunities to build an extensive network to help you in the future. This internship has had tremendous success in placing interns when they graduate college. Past interns work for the Anheuser-Busch, New York State United Teachers, the NYC Partnership, NYS AFL-CIO, the Office of the New York State Comptroller, the U.S. House of Representatives, Eli Lilly, PhRMA, Wells Fargo, and many more. If you are interested, please provide a resume, cover letter, and short writing sample by October 31, 2026 at 5:00PM.

Many of the things that have driven success in the past will not be the same things that drive success in the future as the world navigates evolving energy systems, changing customer needs, digital transformation, geopolitical uncertainty, and rapid technological innovation. If you join Cummins' Corporate Strategy team, you will be at the forefront of helping the company navigate this evolving landscape. As a Corporate Strategy Manager, you will work directly with senior leaders to develop recommendations on Cummins' most important strategic priorities and growth opportunities. You will have ownership initially over an individual workstream and eventually over entire projects, with multiple opportunities to directly present your recommendations to Cummins leaders. Recent projects have included evaluating growth opportunities across existing and adjacent markets, assessing M&A and partnership opportunities, developing market-entry and technology strategies, evaluating geopolitical and supply chain risks, supporting product and platform strategy decisions, exploring digital and AI-enabled business opportunities, and shaping long-term corporate strategy. Corporate Strategy Managers work closely with leaders across product, engineering, commercial, operations, finance, and technology organizations to help guide enterprise decision-making. You will be joining a highly diverse team of similarly driven problem-solvers in the context of an amazing corporate culture that provides a supportive environment and values your work-life balance. Our team heavily focuses on your personal and professional development to propel you to an exciting and fulfilling career at Cummins. Corporate Strategy Managers have gone on to varied and fulfilling careers at Cummins as product managers, commercial leaders, general managers, business development leaders, and strategists. This is an exciting opportunity in Indianapolis, Indiana. The role is hybrid, by which we mean that managers are expected to be present in both locations periodically for stakeholder and team engagement, and work from home is also possible. The expectation is to be in the office 3 days a week. Key attributes of successful candidates include:Strategic thinking and visionStrong analytical and structured problem-solving skillsExcellent verbal and written communication skillsAbility to synthesize complex issues into clear recommendationsAbility to collaborate in a highly multicultural and cross-functional teamPersonal drive, initiative, and intellectual curiosityComfort operating in ambiguous and rapidly changing environmentsPersonal and professional integrity QualificationsCummins Internship Program CriteriaMust be a full-time enrolled student pursuing MBA or similar degree graduating after May 2028Must be able to complete a minimum of 10 weeksMust be able to complete 40 hours per weekWillingness to learn from others on the job ResponsibilitiesLead individual workstreams supporting high-priority strategic initiativesConduct market, customer, competitor, technology, and financial analysisEvaluate growth opportunities across Cummins' core and emerging marketsAssess portfolio, acquisition, partnership, and investment opportunitiesSupport strategic decisions related to technology, product, and market participationAnalyze emerging trends in energy systems, digital technologies, AI, customer needs, and regulatory environmentsEvaluate geopolitical developments, supply chain resilience considerations, and other factors affecting long-term competitivenessSupport enterprise strategic planning, scenario development, and long-range business assessmentsDevelop executive-ready communications and present recommendations to senior leadersFacilitate alignment across diverse stakeholder groups and business functions Compensation and BenefitsBase salary rate commensurate with experience. Additional benefits vary between locations and include options such as our 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan, Cash Balance Pension Plan, Medical/Dental/Life Insurance, Health Savings Account, Domestic Partners Coverage and a full complement of personal and professional benefits. Cummins and E-verifyCummins is an equal employment opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons, without regard to race, sex, color, disability, national origin, age, religion, union affiliation, sexual orientation, veteran status, citizenship, gender identity, and/or expression, or other status protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments to accommodate a health condition or disability, please let us know. Your journey with us matters. Apply for this opportunity to start your career with Cummins today.

What you'll do:Build and update financial models to evaluate investments and track portfolio performancePrepare investment memos, market summaries, and presentations for committees and partnersConduct market research and analyze trends, risks, and opportunitiesAssist with due diligence, data review, and findings documentationMonitor operational and leasing metrics to support reforecasting and strategic planningMaintain deal trackers, timelines, and deliverablesPartner with internal teams to support initiatives and improve performanceQualifications:Strong desire to learn the real estate industryQuantitative background and analytical problem-solving abilityStrong, precise written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex topicsEnrolled in a bachelor's degree program in real estate, finance, business, or a related majorGraduating between December 2027 and May 2028 The Summer Internship Experience:The Greystar Summer Internship Program packs 10 weeks with real projects, real responsibility, and real connections. You'll dive straight into the action on a team like Investment, Finance, Marketing, IT, Data, Leasing, Development, or Operations—doing work that actually moves the needle, not just watching from the sidelines.Along the way, you'll get a front-row seat to the rest of the business too, through:Executive Speaker Series — hear directly from the people leading the industryBusiness Segment Overviews — get the full picture of how each part of Greystar worksMentor Relationships — build connections that go beyond the summerSite Visits — see the work happening in the field, up closeCommunity Outreach — give back alongside your teamNetworking Opportunities — meet people across the company You'll close out the summer by presenting your Final Capstone Project, your chance to show off what you built, what you learned, and the impact you made.Program dates: June 1, 2027 – August 6, 2027The compensation for this position is $30/hour.

jobs.title: Accounting Internship – Summer 2027 at GreatCampJobs
jobs.description: Employer: GreatCampJobs Expires: 10/31/2026 JAccounting. And yes, one field at a time. 😂DescriptionAbout the PositionSpend your summer gaining hands-on accounting experience while living and working in a unique summer camp environment.Our Accounting Internship gives college students the opportunity to apply classroom knowledge to the day-to-day financial operations of a residential summer camp. You'll work alongside camp leadership and administrative staff while gaining practical experience with accounting processes in a fast-paced seasonal organization.Accounting Interns may assist with:Processing invoices and recording cash receiptsPreparing payments and manual checksAssisting with journal entries and general accounting recordsSupporting payroll and staff advance processesManaging petty cash and camper spending accountsMaintaining organized financial records and documentationUsing spreadsheets and accounting software to support daily operationsProviding general administrative and clerical support as neededQualificationsAt least 18 years old by the start of employmentCurrently pursuing a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related fieldAt least two semesters of accounting coursework preferredComfortable using Microsoft Excel and other basic office softwareOrganized, dependable, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple responsibilitiesStrong communication and problem-solving skillsPrevious professional accounting experience is not requiredAbout Working at CampThis isn't a traditional office internship. You'll spend the summer living and working within a residential camp community while gaining practical experience that complements what you're learning in the classroom.You'll develop professional skills, see how accounting supports the daily operations of a complex organization, work alongside experienced staff, and become part of a close-knit summer community.Staff are required to live onsite for the duration of the summer. Accounting Interns primarily work in camp administrative and business operations rather than serving as cabin counselors.Positions generally run from approximately the second week of June through the first week of August, with exact dates varying by camp and position.Compensation is approximately $2,000–$2,700 for the summer, depending on position and experience. Housing, meals, a travel stipend, comprehensive staff training, and scheduled days off are also included.How to ApplyPlease apply directly through GreatCampJobs rather than through Handshake.After submitting your application, qualified candidates will be contacted regarding next steps and potential interviews with our staffing teams.Apply at GreatCampJobs.com

jobs.title: Financial Analyst Intern at Oracle
jobs.description: Employer: Oracle Expires: 10/31/2026 Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. For clarity purposes, this means that Oracle is not in a position now, or in the future, to offer US immigration sponsorship. This includes, but is not limited to, support of H-1B, TN, O-1, green card or F-1 e.g. EAD, OPT, CPT, I-20, F-1 visa stamp etc.DescriptionCome and join us! The world is changing, and Oracle is looking for individuals like you to be a part of that change. We believe transformation is led by individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking. At Oracle, we continue to push forward and innovate, not in spite of challenges, but because of them. We’re looking for motivated students who want to leave their mark at one of the world’s largest B2B technology companies. So, if you’re looking to pursue a career in Finance – and have fun along the way – you’ve come to the right place. The management of finance is an essential aspect, if not the most, of any company. Keeping in mind that, it comes as no surprise that it is considered by many as one of the most challenging fields of work a person can break into. Finance internships have a vital role in gaining an advantage in this industry. Our Finance Interns have broad responsibilities, which may vary from creating financial reports to help develop practices and policies for financial management, accounting, budget control, etc. While working under an experienced mentor, you will further expand your knowledge by working on day-to-day value-add tasks at the company This summer, we are looking for talented individuals who want to kick-start their finance careers and learn from the experts. ResponsibilitiesWhat You’ll DoAs a Financial Analyst Intern, you will:Participate in immersive workshops to develop foundational finance skillsEngage in interactive learning activities and discussions with Oracle executivesCollect and analyze data for financial analysisDraw insights by visualizing, mining, and synthesizing dataCompose and present data-driven recommendations to the finance team Prepare monthly/quarterly financial analysis packets for managementPresent to Management team at end of summer on your project and intern experienceWhat You’ll BringLet’s see what you can achieve when you dare to be yourself. What we are looking for: Rising Senior working towards BA/BS in Finance/AccountingMinimum 3.5 cumulative GPACandidates entering their final year of studies (in the Fall academic year) Proactive self-starter capable of working both independently and in a team environment Exceptional professionalism and work ethic Strong written and verbal communication skills Proficient in Microsoft Office programs (i.e. PowerPoint, Word and Excel) Capacity to learn quickly, adapt to change and work in an objective driven environment Innovative problem solving, analytical and decision-making skills both Qualitative and Quantitative Ability to meet strict deadlines and work under pressure Ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple assignments/projects simultaneously No visa sponsorship available for this positionWhat You’ll ExperienceShadowing and training opportunities with our experienced team of finance professionalsHands-on application of finance principles in a fast-paced work environmentOpportunity to attend weekly meetings and occasional virtual networking events A career at Oracle is defined by you. We give you the freedom—and the skills—to write your own success story. Whatever avenue you go down, you’ll gain priceless learning experiences and be supported to do your best work. QualificationsDisclaimer:Certain US customer or client-facing roles may be required to comply with applicable requirements, such as immunization and occupational health mandates.Range and benefit information provided in this posting are specific to the stated locations onlyUS: Hiring Range in USD from $19.62 to $38.32 per hour; from: $40,800 to $79,700 per annum.Oracle maintains broad salary ranges for its roles in order to account for variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions and locations, as well as reflect Oracle’s differing products, industries and lines of business.Candidates are typically placed into the range based on the preceding factors as well as internal peer equity.Oracle US offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes the following:1. Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including expert medical opinion2. Short term disability and long term disability3. Life insurance and AD&D4. Supplemental life insurance (Employee/Spouse/Child)5. Health care and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts6. Pre-tax commuter and parking benefits7. 401(k) Savings and Investment Plan with company match8. Paid time off: Flexible Vacation is provided to all eligible employees assigned to a salaried (non-overtime eligible) position. Accrued Vacation is provided to all other employees eligible for vacation benefits. For employees working at least 35 hours per week, the vacation accrual rate is 13 days annually for the first three years of employment and 18 days annually for subsequent years of employment. Vacation accrual is prorated for employees working between 20 and 34 hours per week. Employees working fewer than 20 hours per week are not eligible for vacation.9. 11 paid holidays10. Paid sick leave: 72 hours of paid sick leave upon date of hire. Refreshes each calendar year. Unused balance will carry over each year up to a maximum cap of 112 hours.11. Paid parental leave12. Adoption assistance13. Employee Stock Purchase Plan14. Financial planning and group legal15. Voluntary benefits including auto, homeowner and pet insuranceThe role will generally accept applications for at least three calendar days from the posting date or as long as the job remains posted.Career Level - IC0 About UsOnly Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

jobs.feedName: David Nazarian College of Business & Economics
jobs.title: Product Management Winter Internship at Coding it Forward
jobs.description: Employer: Coding it Forward Expires: 10/31/2026 Please note you must apply through our application portal from Wednesday, October 14 - Sunday, October 25, 2026. Applications submitted via third-party websites will not be considered. Coding it Forward is hiring recently graduated students (undergrad, masters, or PhDs) to participate in the Coding it Forward Fellowship, a full-time paid, 10-week winter Fellowship for early-career technologists to innovate in state government. Fellows work across data, design, product, or software to build a more equitable and effective government for all. Fellows have the opportunity to:Get paid while making an impact. You’ll contribute your expertise to some of the most pressing problems facing our country while getting your start in public interest technology. Develop as a mission-driven technologist. You’ll work alongside public servants to apply your technical and problem-solving skills to improve the critical products and services our communities depend on.Grow personally and professionally. You’ll attend weekly events led by top technologists, gain access to a one-on-one mentor, and office hours with the Coding it Forward team. Join a cohort-based community. You’ll build lasting connections with other passionate early-career technologists in your cohort through social activities, group check-ins, and special events.Expand your network. After the winter ends, you’ll join our dynamic network of more than 700 alumni and receive access to job opportunities, professional development resources, and more. Program LogisticsDates: January 11 - March 19, 2027Time Commitment: Full-time, 40 Hours/Week. You must not be actively enrolled in an academic program at the time of the Fellowship.Location: Some roles will be fully remote and some will involve an in-person component. You must be living in the United States for the duration of the program. Equal OpportunityCoding it Forward is committed to diversity and inclusion. In compliance with applicable laws, Coding it Forward provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law. About Coding it ForwardWe’re empowering the next generation of mission-driven technologists.For more information about the Fellowship eligibility and application process, please refer to this one-pager. To explore the specific role requirements and submit an application, visit this link. For any questions, please email fellowship@codingitforward.com
